summary: BEING SOLD BY MODERN METHOD OF AUCTION Situated within a well-established residential area of Bedlington, this two bedroom ground floor apartment enjoys a convenient location close to a wide range of local amenities, making it ideally suited to investors as it is currently tenanted at £525pcm
description:
This property is for sale by the Modern Method of Auction, meaning the buyer and seller are to Complete within 56 days (the "Reservation Period"). Interested parties personal data will be shared with the Auctioneer (iamsold). If considering buying with a mortgage, inspect and consider the property carefully with your lender before bidding. A Buyer Information Pack is provided. The winning bidder will pay £349.00 including VAT for this pack which you must view before bidding. The buyer signs a Reservation Agreement and makes payment of a non-refundable Reservation Fee of 4.50% of the purchase price including VAT, subject to a minimum of £6,600.00 including VAT. This is paid to reserve the property to the buyer during the Reservation Period and is paid in addition to the purchase price. This is considered within calculations for Stamp Duty Land Tax. Services may be recommended by the Agent or Auctioneer in which they will receive payment from the service provider if the service is taken. Payment varies but will be no more than £450.00. These services are optional.The property is within easy reach of Bedlington town centre which offers an excellent selection of shops, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants and everyday services, together with local schools and healthcare facilities. Nearby parks, walking routes and recreational amenities provide excellent opportunities for outdoor leisure and family activities, while the beautiful Northumberland coastline and surrounding countryside are also easily accessible. For commuters, the property benefits from excellent transport links with convenient access to the A189 and A1, providing straightforward travel to Newcastle, Morpeth and surrounding North East towns. Public transport routes are also close by, making this an ideal location for those needing to commute whilst still enjoying a welcoming community setting. The property itself offers spacious accommodation throughout and briefly comprises a spacious lounge, kitchen, two bedrooms and bathroom. Externally, there is a shared courtyard together with an allocated parking space to the rear, providing additional practicality and convenience. The property itself offers spacious accommodation throughout and presents an excellent opportunity for investors seeking a home within this popular and convenient location.

LOUNGE / DINER A spacious and inviting lounge benefitting from two UPVC framed double glazed windows allowing for an abundance of natural light, creating a bright and airy atmosphere throughout. The room also features a radiator for added comfort together with a useful built-in storage cupboard providing practical additional storage and space for a dining table and chairs.

KITCHEN Fitted with a range of wall and base units, the kitchen offers ample storage and preparation space, complemented by laminate work surfaces for practicality and ease of maintenance. Features include an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap, plumbing for an automatic washing machine, and space for a cooker together with a tall fridge freezer. The room further benefits from a radiator, a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for natural light, and a UPVC framed double glazed door providing access out to the rear shared courtyard with gated access.

BEDROOM ONE A well-proportioned double bedroom benefitting from a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for plenty of natural light, together with a radiator creating a warm and comfortable atmosphere.

BEDROOM TWO A comfortable and versatile second bedroom benefitting from a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for natural light, together with a radiator providing warmth and comfort throughout the year.

FAMILY BATHROOM The bathroom is fitted with a three-piece suite comprising a panelled bath with electric shower over, wash hand basin and WC. The room further benefits from a radiator and a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for natural light and ventilation, creating a practical and comfortable space for everyday use.

EXTERNALLY Externally, the property benefits from a shared courtyard with gated access, providing a practical outdoor space. In addition, there is an allocated parking space located to the rear within the alley behind the property, offering added convenience for off-road parking.
